equipmentTemplates.name: Iron Dagger
equipmentTemplates.description: A short blade honed from iron. Reliable in close quarters.

equipmentTemplates.name: Iron Sword
equipmentTemplates.description: A straight iron sword, workhorse of the Aeldran roads.

equipmentTemplates.name: Stone Axe
equipmentTemplates.description: A heavy axe with a hand-knapped stone head. Brutal and primitive.

equipmentTemplates.name: Battle Hammer
equipmentTemplates.description: A two-handed maul fitted with an iron-capped head. Bone-breaking.

equipmentTemplates.name: War Pick
equipmentTemplates.description: A compact pick with a hardened iron point. Punches through plate.

equipmentTemplates.name: Thornwood Bow
equipmentTemplates.description: A recurve bow carved from resilient thornwood.

equipmentTemplates.name: Hunter's Crossbow
equipmentTemplates.description: A compact crossbow favored by Aeldran forest scouts.

equipmentTemplates.name: Sling
equipmentTemplates.description: A simple sling of woven sinew. Cheap but accurate.

equipmentTemplates.name: Oak Wand
equipmentTemplates.description: A slender oak wand that channels Weave with little resistance.

equipmentTemplates.name: Crystal Focus
equipmentTemplates.description: A multifaceted crystal sphere that amplifies magical resonance.

equipmentTemplates.name: Ashwood Staff
equipmentTemplates.description: A tall ashwood staff worn smooth by long use. Reliable conduit.

equipmentTemplates.name: Leather Cap
equipmentTemplates.description: Cured hide shaped into a simple helm.

equipmentTemplates.name: Scale Coif
equipmentTemplates.description: Overlapping iron scales form a tight hood.

equipmentTemplates.name: Iron Helm
equipmentTemplates.description: A forged iron helm with a narrow visor. Heavy but protective.

equipmentTemplates.name: Fur Hood
equipmentTemplates.description: A thick fur hood sewn from heavy pelts. Warm and surprisingly resilient.

equipmentTemplates.name: Leather Vest
equipmentTemplates.description: A padded leather body vest offering moderate protection.

equipmentTemplates.name: Chain Shirt
equipmentTemplates.description: Interlocked iron rings form a flexible hauberk.

equipmentTemplates.name: Padded Gambeson
equipmentTemplates.description: Layers of quilted cloth that absorb shock surprisingly well.

equipmentTemplates.name: Leather Leggings
equipmentTemplates.description: Thick leather greaves strapped over the thighs and shins.

equipmentTemplates.name: Iron Greaves
equipmentTemplates.description: Solid iron plates that guard the legs from knee to ankle.

equipmentTemplates.name: Padded Trousers
equipmentTemplates.description: Quilted trousers reinforced at vulnerable joints.

equipmentTemplates.name: Leather Gloves
equipmentTemplates.description: Supple leather gauntlets offering grip and minor protection.

equipmentTemplates.name: Iron Vambraces
equipmentTemplates.description: Hinged iron arm guards strapped over the forearms.

equipmentTemplates.name: Wrapped Handguards
equipmentTemplates.description: Strips of heavy cloth wound tight around the knuckles and wrists.

equipmentTemplates.name: Leather Boots
equipmentTemplates.description: Sturdy boots of thick-tanned hide. Dependable on rough trails.

equipmentTemplates.name: Iron Sabatons
equipmentTemplates.description: Articulated iron foot armor. Loud on stone, solid everywhere.

equipmentTemplates.name: Traveler's Sandals
equipmentTemplates.description: Light sandals of braided leather. Fast and quiet.

equipmentTemplates.name: Bone Ring
equipmentTemplates.description: A ring carved from yellowed bone. Carries a faint Wyrd resonance.

equipmentTemplates.name: Silver Amulet
equipmentTemplates.description: A small silver disc on a chain, engraved with a warding sigil.

equipmentTemplates.name: Wyrd Charm
equipmentTemplates.description: A knotted cord strung with crystalline fragments. Unsettling to hold.

equipmentTemplates.name: Iron Ore
equipmentTemplates.description: Rough lumps of iron ore, ready for the smelter.

equipmentTemplates.name: Beast Hide
equipmentTemplates.description: Thick hide stripped from a slain creature.

equipmentTemplates.name: Sinew
equipmentTemplates.description: Dried sinew — useful in bowstrings and bindings.

equipmentTemplates.name: Thornwood Herb
equipmentTemplates.description: A bitter medicinal herb found only in the Thornwood.

equipmentTemplates.name: Dravenite Dust
equipmentTemplates.description: Fine crystalline powder with latent magical resonance. Used in restoration imbuing.

equipmentTemplates.name: Bone Fragment
equipmentTemplates.description: A large bone fragment — useful as a crafting material.

equipmentTemplates.name: Wyrd Shard
equipmentTemplates.description: A jagged shard of crystallised Wyrd-energy. Handle with care.

rareSlotBoost.comment: At danger>=threshold each listed slot's templates are added one extra copy to the pool (doubling their weight).

Bone bleached and hardened by desert heat. Still serviceable.

Tier-1 herb whose root anchors against desert winds.

A large iridescent scale from an aquatic creature.

A lustrous pearl from a coastal mollusk. Valuable and magically receptive.
Salt-treated wood washed ashore. Rot-resistant and light.
A chunk of living coral harvested from tidal pools. Used in water-aligned crafting.

A clear quartz washed smooth by tides. A neutral enchantment substrate.
A lustrous black pearl from the deepest Fairgean brood pools. A master-tier wyrd imbuing reagent.
Tier-1 herb that grows hardy along coastal cliffs.
Tier-1 herb. Grows in tidal meadows above the splash zone.
A tier-2 herb: long ribbons of kelp pulled from cold coastal waters.
A pale iridescent seed rarely washed up from the Fairgean tides. Plant in a Greenhouse.
Iron ore smelted from swamp deposits. Crude but plentiful.
A vial of milky toxin harvested from a marsh toad. Potent poison reagent.

A fragile crystal formed around a pocket of volatile marsh gas.
A thick, dark fluid drained from marsh leeches. Prized by healers.
A violet amethyst pulled from a bog-bed. A solidified weave-echo of wyrd/aether.
Tier-1 herb. Persists even in sodden peat soil.
Tier-1 herb. Fragrant clumps rise from drier hummocks.
A tier-2 herb harvested only from brackish marsh water. Used by healers.
Soft white fiber from plains cotton plants. Basic cloth material.
Coarse hair from a plains horse. Used in bowstrings and rope.
Tanned hide from a plains herd animal. Standard armor material.
A piece of flint knapped to a sharp edge. Essential for tool making.
A bundle of harvested wheat. Ingredient in future food crafting.
A small nugget of soft copper ore. Used in basic metalworking.
A large plume from a plains bird. Used in air-aligned crafting.
A clear quartz crystal turned up by a plains plough. A neutral enchantment substrate.

Tier-1 herb abundant across the plains. The staple reagent.
Tier-1 herb growing wild in meadows.
Tier-1 herb with calming floral notes. Common on open plains.
A jagged shard of crystallised fate-energy. Handle with extreme care.
A swirling mote of energy drawn from a tear in reality. Extremely rare.
Fine crystalline powder with latent magical resonance. Used in imbuing.
A sliver of broken reality. Hums faintly and distorts nearby shadows.
A gossamer thread that phases between planes. Used to weave enchantments.

A lustrous black pearl, found only where the Maw touches water. Master-tier wyrd imbuing reagent.
A flawless diamond with a faint violet cast — Maw-kissed and universally compatible with imbuing currents.

A flask of swirling violet liquid. Restores 50 Weave when consumed.
A dark amber brew that hardens the body. +10% max HP for next combat.
A clear, fizzing draught that quickens the limbs. +20% speed for next combat.
A thick red tonic with a sharp bite. +15% strike damage for next combat.
